speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue and unintentional weight loss, which are significant symptoms we need to investigate. Can you tell me if you have experienced any changes in your bowel habits, such as diarrhea or blood in the stool, or any abdominal pain?

text: 72-year-old male. The patient reports a 6-month history of fatigue and an unintentional weight loss of 5 kg (11 lb) despite maintaining a good appetite. He denies any recent changes in his diet or physical activity. He takes no medications and does not smoke or use illicit drugs.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your age and symptoms, I need to rule out malignancy. Do you have any abdominal pain, changes in bowel habits, or blood in your stool?
